entries.question: IBKR managed account callback 是否始终提供 accountName 未由本地源证明；缺失时必须由连接选定 AccountScope 注入并保留 provenance。
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:454-457 retains only the first managed-account token, while updatePortfolio/updateAccountValue/accountDownloadEnd receive accountName at :604-660; C01/K02 require explicit AccountScope and reject inferred defaults.
entries.resolution: Retain the empirical prerequisite. Decode an AccountDirectory and selected AccountScope separately; inject a selected scope only with provenance. Missing or mismatched accountName is ScopeDiscoveryPending/ScopeMismatch and quarantined, never attributed to a default account or subaccount.

entries.question: 测试 payload 的 SDK 版本兼容性需在实现 slice 锁定；当前不声称已验证。
entries.evidence: request-bridge.spec.ts:5 imports @traderalice/ibkr and lines 21-58 exercise only the greeting/nextValidId fixture; no runtime or ABI compatibility observation is present.
entries.resolution: Retain the implementation evidence requirement. Use the pinned SDK adapter boundary, but until an executable compatibility probe for the selected SDK version passes, do not claim version compatibility or authorize a native capability from this fixture alone.

entries.question: SDK 在 close 后是否仍会异步发 nextValidId 未由 wrapper 证明，必须以 attempt token 丢弃。
entries.evidence: request-bridge.spec.ts:60-91 destroys the socket and observes prompt handshake rejection, but it does not establish whether the SDK emits late nextValidId callbacks after close.
entries.resolution: Retain the native ordering prerequisite. Fence every callback by attempt and ConnectionGeneration; late nextValidId becomes StaleCallback evidence and cannot settle a replacement attempt or readiness.

entries.question: EClient 额外协议 timer 生命周期未由当前测试证明；实现需覆盖 socket close 证据。
entries.evidence: request-bridge.spec.ts:93-121 observes a silent peer, timeout, and disconnected client, but it does not expose EClient internal protocol-timer ownership or cleanup.
entries.resolution: Retain the resource-lifecycle prerequisite. Scope finalization and the timeout handler must close the attempt socket/listeners exactly once; until cleanup is observed, capability stays unavailable and late callbacks are stale diagnostics.

entries.question: 10089 wording varies by TWS version；code 是 evidence，registry 需版本化。
entries.evidence: request-bridge.spec.ts:124-133 proves request-specific 10089 routing, while the target NativeErrorEnvelope already carries code and redacted message; no consumer needs wording equality.
entries.resolution: Treat native wording as opaque redacted diagnostics. Route by numeric code plus adapter protocol/version evidence; if registry evidence is absent, retain UnknownNativeError/ObservationFailure and never let wording or regex establish rejection.

entries.question: Exact meaning of every 21xx code not locally enumerated; unknown members remain informational.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.spec.ts:135-139 covers only 2104 and requires no throw with no pending request; it does not enumerate the complete 21xx registry or cross-version meanings.
entries.resolution: Retain the native-code prerequisite. Preserve every unregistered 21xx envelope as InformationalFarmStatus/capability evidence, do not reject unrelated waiters, and do not upgrade health or readiness without explicit mapping evidence.

entries.question: 1101 “data maintained” does not prove private account subscriptions; design requires reach check.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.spec.ts:141-157 shows 1100 dead and 1102 restored while still dead, but neither source nor fixture proves private account subscription continuity after 1101.
entries.resolution: Retain the reach prerequisite. 1101/1102 remain hints only; resubscribe/rebaseline and commit an account checkpoint before ReadinessConfirmed or write capability.

entries.question: Native currentTime unit/clock skew contract must be recorded; source only treats it as seconds.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:277-307 and :802-806 pass a bare number through currentTime; the fixture uses epoch-like values but does not establish broker clock accuracy or skew semantics.
entries.resolution: Retain the clock-semantics prerequisite. Decode finite non-negative Unix seconds and record receivedAt; require an explicit consumer ClockSkewPolicy for any health interpretation, otherwise keep the observation diagnostic-only.

entries.question: SDK may throw after bytes written is unknown; if unprovable classify probe ambiguity, never mutation authority.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.spec.ts:177-190 proves synchronous reqCurrentTime throw clears the local probe and permits a later retry, but cannot show whether bytes were written before the throw.
entries.resolution: Retain send-boundary ambiguity. Classify failed probe as ProbeSendFailure/ambiguous evidence, clear only local generation-scoped probe state so a later probe has fresh correlation, and never use the throw to claim no remote effect or authorize controlled mutation retry.

entries.question: Spec injects no instrument/currency context; adapter must require metadata or return an explicit PublicMarket/AccountScoped subject, never an unscoped observation。
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:220-229 registers a snapshot with only reqId and resolveOnBidAsk, and the fixture at :192-200 supplies no instrument/currency/subject context.
entries.resolution: Require caller-supplied InstrumentId, CurrencyCode, and explicit Public or AccountScoped subject in SnapshotRequest. Missing context yields ObservationFailure(MissingSnapshotContext); no unscoped or inferred quote is emitted.

entries.question: IBKR may emit end without all fields; required-field policy must be explicit caller input.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.spec.ts:202-217 proves ordinary snapshots wait for tickSnapshotEnd in that fixture, but does not prove every IBKR end marker carries all required fields.
entries.resolution: Retain the native completeness prerequisite. Caller policy names required fields; an end marker missing them yields Partial/Missing or ObservationFailure with retained evidence, never zero-filled Complete.

entries.question: IBKR ordering between downloadEnd/deltas across reconnect unavailable; gaps force rebaseline.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.spec.ts:220-237 documents full bursts ending at accountDownloadEnd and deltas without an end marker, but does not establish strict ordering across reconnect generations.
entries.resolution: Retain ordering prerequisite. Assign local receive evidence, mark generation gaps, and require fresh baseline/checkpoint before readiness; never merge unproven reconnect order as authoritative. This is data reconciliation, not order state.

entries.question: IBKR callback lacks explicit stream sequence; adapter assigns receive sequence and marks reconnect gaps.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:604-642 updatePortfolio has no native sequence parameter; the callback source therefore cannot supply one.
entries.resolution: Use an adapter-assigned receiveSequence and retain generation/freshness. A reconnect or detected gap is ReconciliationGap requiring rebaseline; local sequence is not presented as a broker ordering guarantee.

entries.question: Zero may represent no position vs transient row; design treats scoped callback as conclusive only with source-quality evidence.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:614-624 and request-bridge.spec.ts:249-255 treat zero quantity as removal, but source does not prove whether every zero row is a final closure rather than transient/incomplete evidence.
entries.resolution: Retain the native row-semantics prerequisite. Accept zero as ClosedPosition only with scoped/source-quality evidence; otherwise quarantine as uncertain and keep the projection conservative rather than inventing an open or closed state.

entries.question: IBKR tag families not exhaustive; codec versions families and preserves unknown qualified rows.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:644-658 names several tag families in comments but exposes arbitrary key/value/currency strings and no exhaustive family registry.
entries.resolution: Retain unknown tag-family evidence. Version the codec, preserve qualified unknown rows, map only known families, and return Partial/CapabilityUnavailable for consumers requiring complete typed coverage.

entries.question: conId uniqueness across linked accounts unproven; always bind AccountScope and validate metadata.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:593-601 keys positions only by conId and discards accountName in updatePortfolio; no source proves conId identity/uniqueness across linked accounts.
entries.resolution: Retain identity evidence as a prerequisite. Always bind observations to AccountScope and validate contract metadata; conflicting or unscoped conId rows are quarantined and cannot overwrite another scope.

entries.question: No native full-download sequence exposed; adapter assigns receive sequence and marks uncertainty requiring rebaseline.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:604-678 exposes no broker sequence or full-download cursor on portfolio/accountDownloadEnd callbacks.
entries.resolution: Use adapterReceiveSequence only as local evidence and retain tombstones through coverage/generation boundaries. A reconnect gap forces rebaseline; an old full row cannot resurrect a newer closure.

entries.question: Test hardcodes DU1; accountId vs subAccountId mapping requires explicit fixture input, not inference.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.spec.ts:17-19 hardcodes DU1 in the fixture; C01/K02 require explicit AccountScope even for a single wallet.
entries.resolution: Make fixture construction accept explicit AccountScope and base-currency metadata. Remove the DU1/private-cache assumption; missing scope or metadata is a typed fixture/configuration failure and cannot be inferred from a callback.

entries.question: Tag family semantics incomplete; only explicit BASE authoritative, absent BASE remains provisional.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:644-654 preserves currency-qualified rows and reserves the plain key for BASE, but the source does not enumerate all tag-family semantics.
entries.resolution: Retain unknown family semantics. Only explicit BASE is authoritative for consolidated display; all other rows remain qualified/provisional with provenance, and absent BASE never becomes synthetic consolidation.

entries.question: BASE may be absent indefinitely; callers handle Provisional rather than silently convert.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.spec.ts:304-311 covers late BASE correction after HKD, but no source proves BASE is always eventually emitted by IBKR.
entries.resolution: Retain availability uncertainty. Keep Provisional selection when BASE is absent, preserve every qualified currency row, and return CapabilityUnavailable for strict consolidated queries instead of silently converting.

entries.question: Intended base currency must come from config/metadata, not this callback.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:644-658 receives a callback currency but no account-base configuration; C01 keeps scope/configuration separate from native row labels.
entries.resolution: Require intended base currency from explicit AccountScope/configuration/metadata. Callback currency remains observation provenance only; a single USD NetLiquidation uses SingleSendFallback and never creates synthetic FX.

entries.question: Target module/file split and package barrel order must be coordinated with Main; no native SDK object should be re-exported.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:1-37 shows one class owning callbacks, clients, collectors, and raw SDK types; K01-K03/K07 require a typed UTA-facing boundary while allowing provider-local module/process freedom.
entries.resolution: Fix provider boundary to named responsibilities or equivalent adapter implementation: versioned codecs, scoped resource ownership, read/data interpreters, and separately declared controlled-effect leaves. A global broker/action map is not target; raw SDK stays private and composition root owns Layer.

entries.question: Exact default durations are operational tuning, not proven guarantees; keep configurable and empirical.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:39-41 contains source defaults of 10,000ms, 12,500ms, and 20,000ms; no native source treats them as protocol guarantees.
entries.resolution: Use BrokerTimeoutConfig with source-compatible defaults (handshake/read 10s, snapshot 12.5s, account baseline 20s) and explicit overrides. These are operational policy values only; state-aware classification still makes post-DispatchStarted timeout Unknown.

entries.question: IBKR native reqId/orderId uniqueness across reconnect/clientId is unverified; adapter must retain lookup evidence and conservative collision handling.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:43-49 and :113-120 use process-local numeric reqId/orderId counters; source does not prove uniqueness across reconnects or client IDs.
entries.resolution: Retain native identity uncertainty. Keep ConnectionId/generation and durable lookup evidence with each native ID, reject collisions conservatively, and never reuse an ambiguous ID or treat it as DispatchId.

entries.question: Whether one native reqId can be reused before late callback is unknown; avoid reuse within generation horizon until evidence.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:50-60 maps pending state only by native numeric IDs and exposes no late-callback reuse horizon.
entries.resolution: Retain the reuse-horizon prerequisite. Fence IDs by connection/generation and retain them until the configured observation horizon or rebaseline evidence; duplicate/late callbacks become StaleCallback, not a new request result.

entries.question: IBKR listing completeness and callback namespace coverage/idempotency are unproven; expose Partial/Unavailable until empirical evidence.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:61-90 uses singleton collectors and :780-798 resolves on end callbacks without namespace/cursor coverage evidence.
entries.resolution: Retain listing completeness prerequisite. Complete requires declared namespace and end/cursor evidence; otherwise Partial/Unavailable, never [] as absence/cancellation proof. Listing/read durability is separate from order DispatchStarted/Observe.

entries.question: Health event sequence persistence policy may be chosen by Main; design requires evidence fields either way.
entries.evidence: C06/K11 require durable capability-affecting health evidence with connection/generation/scope fields; the exact composition-owned writer is an integration choice.
entries.resolution: Persist every capability-affecting health event through the composition-owned durable health-evidence writer with ConnectionId, generation, scope evidence, and monotonic local sequence; rebuild health projection from those facts. Informational farm noise may be metrics-only and never grants readiness.

entries.question: Shared-client reuse policy in composition root needs explicit owner; no implicit setter compatibility shim.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:104-111 exposes mutable setClient/setConnectionStateListener setters; K01/K07 require scoped connection ownership and typed callbacks without a setter compatibility shim.
entries.resolution: One scoped IbkrConnectionLayer owns one EClient per ConnectionId/generation and the composition root owns its lifetime. Do not reuse clients by default; any explicit shared resource needs its own owner and never a setter shim.

entries.question: IBKR account string format and subaccount semantics not proven; preserve opaque AccountId and require explicit directory evidence.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:454-457 splits an opaque managedAccounts string and stores only accounts[0]; no source establishes account token format or subaccount semantics.
entries.resolution: Retain opaque AccountId and AccountDirectory evidence. Preserve all managed-account tokens with revision, do not infer stable ordering or subaccounts, require explicit requested AccountScope, and keep unknown format as ScopeDiscoveryPending/UnknownScope rather than default account capability.

entries.question: Whether EClient.connect rejection means bytes were sent is native unknown; treat post-connect mutation state separately and never infer transaction retry.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:130-183 races EClient.connect with nextValidId and disconnects on failure, but EClient does not expose whether a rejected connect wrote bytes.
entries.resolution: Retain connect-boundary ambiguity. Separate connection failure from any durable dispatch state; do not infer transaction retry or no remote effect from connect rejection, and fence late callbacks by attempt/generation.

entries.question: Exact SDK callback ordering after disconnect remains empirical; token fence is mandatory.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:185-196 clears local waiter/timer and :446-452 resolves on nextValidId, but the source does not establish callback ordering after disconnect.
entries.resolution: Retain callback-order uncertainty. Complete the attempt once, release socket/listeners, and classify post-release callbacks as stale evidence unable to revive health or settle another attempt.

entries.question: Native broker may acknowledge synchronously or asynchronously; DispatchStarted boundary must be explicit in interpreter.
entries.evidence: IbkrBroker.ts:495-498, :531-533, and :549-551 invoke void EClient mutators after local waiter registration; C04/K08 fix durable DispatchStarted immediately before a potentially emitting native mutator.
entries.resolution: The controlled-effect interpreter writes DispatchStarted immediately before any potentially emitting native mutator; read leaves retain finite timeout/error schemas. Synchronous return/throw and asynchronous callback timing cannot move the effect boundary, and ambiguous post-boundary results remain Unknown/Observe rather than generic read rejection.

entries.question: Tick timestamp/currency source for every callback must be supplied by request context or marked unavailable; do not invent.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:220-229 accepts only reqId and resolveOnBidAsk, and tick callbacks at :682-734 do not carry currency/InstrumentId context.
entries.resolution: Make SnapshotRequest context mandatory: caller supplies InstrumentId, CurrencyCode, and explicit subject. Missing context is MissingSnapshotContext; the adapter does not infer Public or AccountScoped identity from a tick.

entries.question: IBKR callback provides permId/clientId inconsistently in current types; native lookup completeness remains empirical and controls capability.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:738-762 exposes permId/clientId parameters on orderStatus but openOrder/completedOrder and callback delivery completeness/uniqueness are not established across native paths.
entries.resolution: Retain native lookup capability gating. Preserve PermIdPresent/Absent and ClientIdPresent/Absent evidence, keep dispatch association Unknown when fields or callback coverage are insufficient, and never infer cross-reconnect uniqueness.

entries.question: Server timestamp seconds and skew tolerance need explicit protocol config; no native guarantee inferred.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:277-305 and :802-805 pass a number; request-bridge.spec.ts:170-188 uses epoch-second-shaped values but no tolerance policy exists.
entries.resolution: Use the source-compatible UnixSeconds adapter decode contract without claiming native clock authority, and require caller-supplied ClockSkewPolicy (or retain skew as NotComputed). A valid probe is health evidence only; missing tolerance cannot authorize readiness or writes.

entries.question: Whether reqAccountUpdates callback accountName exactly matches managedAccounts token is empirical; mismatch must quarantine.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:311-347 starts account updates and resolves at accountDownloadEnd, but :604-660 does not prove accountName token equality with managedAccounts.
entries.resolution: Retain the account-name matching prerequisite. Compare callback accountName with directory evidence; mismatch or absent evidence is quarantined/ScopeMismatch and cannot advance BaselinePending to ReadinessConfirmed.

entries.question: Native callback uniqueness/horizon unknown; retain evidence for duplicate events and avoid blind id reuse.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:351-395 clears local pending maps and resolves callback values but exposes no native callback uniqueness or late-delivery horizon.
entries.resolution: Retain duplicate/horizon uncertainty. Use typed event identity plus generation fences and idempotent reducers; duplicate/late events are evidence/no-op, and IDs are not reused within the configured horizon.

entries.question: Exact point at which IBKR bytes cross remote boundary is not exposed by EClient; interpreter marks DispatchStarted before send.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:397-440 blanket-rejects local waiters on connection loss, while IbkrBroker.ts:495-551 invokes void native mutators with no exposed byte boundary.
entries.resolution: Retain remote-boundary prerequisite for controlled effects. DispatchStarted precedes send; after it socket loss yields OutcomeUnknown plus Observe/RecoveryRequired, never blind resend. Read waiters/streams expose unavailable/degraded results and retain freshness.

entries.question: Account managed list ordering and accountName/subaccount guarantees remain empirical; never infer stable ordering.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:454-457 preserves only the first comma-separated account token and :604-660 callbacks carry opaque accountName strings; no ordering or subaccount guarantee is present.
entries.resolution: Retain directory semantics as empirical. Preserve all tokens with revision, never infer stable ordering or subaccounts, require explicit scope selection, and quarantine callback rows lacking matching scope evidence.

entries.question: Semantics/completeness of native error codes vary by TWS version; unregistered code remains conservative Unknown/Capability failure.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:488-517 and ibkr-contracts.ts:42-76 hard-code a partial error classifier; neither source enumerates cross-version semantics for every 21xx/10xxx/unknown code.
entries.resolution: Retain versioned native-error evidence. Known code mappings remain scoped and conservative; unregistered or version-mismatched codes preserve code/message evidence as UnknownNativeError/CapabilityUnavailable/ObservationFailure and cannot settle mutations.

entries.question: Native contract description field completeness and issuer/leaf rules require empirical registry; unknown stays non-tradeable.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:521-540 forwards raw ContractDescription/ContractDetails through generic collectors; source does not establish field completeness or conId=0 issuer/leaf semantics for every native response.
entries.resolution: Retain catalog evidence gating. Versioned decoding leaves malformed/incomplete/hub results non-tradeable until Instrument identity is proven; catalog visibility alone does not declare order leaf.

entries.question: IBKR expiry encoding and exchange parameter multiplicity need empirical versioned codec; do not infer tradeability.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:542-563 sorts raw expiration strings and numeric strikes, but source does not establish all expiry encodings or exchange multiplicity across versions.
entries.resolution: Retain versioned option codec evidence. Parse canonical Expiry/Price/Multiplier and exchange coverage; unknown encoding/multiplicity yields Partial/Unavailable and never an executable chain or implied order capability.

entries.question: Tag coverage and duplicate semantics from IBKR are not established; expose coverage ADT and conservative incomplete.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:565-580 stores only tag/value in a Map and resolves on accountSummaryEnd; source does not establish tag coverage or duplicate-row semantics.
entries.resolution: Retain summary completeness uncertainty. Preserve scoped/currency rows, duplicates, unknown tags, and adapter receive evidence; expose Partial/Unavailable when declared coverage is missing and do not claim native latest-wins without source identity.

entries.question: ConId-to-InstrumentId mapping and metadata conflict policy require catalog evidence; unresolved identity is not tradeable.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:593-601 keys by conId and :604-642 discards accountName while using raw contract metadata; source does not prove a durable conId-to-InstrumentId mapping or conflict resolution.
entries.resolution: Retain catalog identity gating. Resolve conId plus metadata to InstrumentId only with catalog evidence; conflicts/unresolved identity become IdentityConflict/Unavailable and cannot become tradeable or overwrite a scoped projection.

entries.question: IBKR avgCost multiplier convention is documented in source comments but native variants need runtime evidence; unsupported convention must fail closed.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:617-638 documents the per-contract averageCost normalization and pass-through marketValue, but comments/source do not establish that convention for every native derivative variant.
entries.resolution: Retain unit-convention evidence. Apply avgCost/multiplier normalization only when evidenced; unsupported/conflicting semantics preserve raw data and return ObservationFailure(UnsupportedUnit)/CapabilityUnavailable for normalized consumers, without inventing an order effect.

entries.question: IBKR accountDownloadEnd ordering and completeness across reconnect unproven; Readiness requires explicit coverage evidence.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:644-678 swaps on accountDownloadEnd and request-bridge.spec.ts:220-237 covers one sequence, but reconnect ordering/completeness and absence of a native cursor are unproven.
entries.resolution: Retain baseline completeness uncertainty. DownloadEnd commits data-projection readiness only with coverage/checkpoint evidence; reconnect gaps/missing end/incomplete rows remain pending/partial and trigger rebaseline. Account rows never enter controlled-effect approval/compensation.

entries.question: IBKR tick-code meanings beyond listed constants need versioned evidence; unknown ticks are preserved as raw diagnostic, not mapped.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:682-734 maps a listed subset of tick codes and parses type 45, but no source enumerates all tick-code meanings across TWS versions.
entries.resolution: Retain versioned tick evidence. Decode registered codes; unknown ticks remain raw diagnostics, malformed required values are ProtocolViolation, and no unknown code supplies price/currency/entitlement/live quality.

entries.question: permId/clientId and callback completeness vary; native lookup descriptor remains capability-gated.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:738-798 shows permId/clientId fields only on orderStatus and resolves batches on end callbacks, without proving callback completeness, namespace coverage, or cross-reconnect identity.
entries.resolution: Retain native lookup/callback capability gating. Preserve identity-present/absent evidence and order observations; missing association or incomplete listing remains StillWorking/Unknown/Partial and never becomes Ack, fill, cancellation, or absence.

entries.question: Native timestamp clock semantics/skew are unproven; consumers must declare tolerance.
entries.evidence: request-bridge.ts:802-805 forwards the bare currentTime number and silently ignores callbacks after cleanup; source has no clock authority or skew proof.
entries.resolution: Retain timestamp-semantics uncertainty. Validate Unix-second shape and generation/correlation, record receivedAt, and require explicit consumer skew tolerance; stale or untrusted clock evidence cannot establish readiness or alter dispatch state.
